guitar.evidence: Carl Wilson played electric guitar (Fender models) in the Beach Boys, but the band's sound is vocal/production-driven, not guitar-iconic.

tone.target: bright surf clean with spring reverb and twang
tone.profile: bright surf clean with spring reverb and twang
tone.summary: A classic surf-rock chain featuring a light boost for attack, followed by a pristine US Deluxe amp simulation, paired with the US 2x12 cab. Modulation includes Chorus (used lightly) and Tremolo to achieve the required bright, clean, twangy sound, topped off with Spring reverb.
